legacy_inventory.local_acceptance_note: The existing README describes reviewed conversions, but this review did not reconcile each retained file against the newer source-acceptance gate. No local file is newly accepted by this register.

policy: A human-reviewed official link is usable for ordinary research within the identified publisher, instrument, language, displayed date or cutoff, reviewed content, and limitations. A government-published consolidated text is preferred when available. No Gazette-fragment reconstruction, local capture, hash, replay, conversion, API access, or copying permission is required for link use. Check a specific later amendment only when it may materially affect the issue. Link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, and country completion.

ro-portal-208825.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-208825.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 8 March 2024.
ro-portal-208825.scope: Official consolidated record for OUG nr. 102/2005 on free movement of EU, EEA, and Swiss citizens in Romania and the associated family-member framework.
ro-portal-208825.reviewed_content: The page identifies the instrument and publisher, shows a consolidated-form selector and dated history, and provides the statutory contents and article links.
limitations: The displayed consolidation cutoff is 8 March 2024; later material changes must be checked when they affect the provision at issue.
This source-reference decision is not an article-by-article legal coverage finding and does not establish that every family route or procedure is adequately covered.
It does not accept the existing local conversion or any attachment as a local artifact.

ro-portal-136986.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-136986.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 7 June 2022.
ro-portal-136986.scope: Official consolidated HG nr. 1.864/2006 approving the OUG nr. 102/2005 implementing rules and the forms for EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and family members.
ro-portal-136986.reviewed_content: The page identifies the instrument, its subject, consolidated-form history, and annex links in the contents.
limitations: The displayed consolidation cutoff is 7 June 2022; check a later material change when relevant.
The annex models were not visually reviewed in this link assessment.
The link does not establish complete procedure coverage or accept a stored conversion.

ro-portal-136987.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-136987.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 7 June 2022.
ro-portal-136987.scope: Official republished methodological rules applying OUG nr. 102/2005.
ro-portal-136987.reviewed_content: The page identifies the implementing rules, their relationship to OUG nr. 102/2005, the consolidated-history date, and the article contents.
limitations: Use the republished rules linked here rather than the superseded original 2006 wording.
The displayed consolidation cutoff is 7 June 2022; check a later material change when relevant.
This is not an article-by-article implementation or topic-completeness finding.

ro-portal-50236.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-50236.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 27 April 2026.
ro-portal-50236.scope: Official consolidated OUG nr. 194/2002 governing the general regime of foreigners in Romania.
ro-portal-50236.reviewed_content: The page identifies the instrument and its subject and exposes the consolidated form and dated version history.
limitations: Use this as the general foreigners regime; do not substitute it for the special OUG nr. 102/2005 EU-family rules.
The displayed cutoff is 27 April 2026; later material changes must be checked when relevant.
This decision does not determine the interaction of individual provisions or accept the local conversion.

ro-portal-298762.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-298762.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 10 July 2025.
ro-portal-298762.scope: Official consolidated Law nr. 554/2004 on administrative litigation.
ro-portal-298762.reviewed_content: The page identifies the instrument, its consolidated history, and the contents for administrative-court procedure and remedies.
limitations: The displayed cutoff is 10 July 2025; check a later material change when relevant.
The exact remedy, deadline, preliminary procedure, and effect of silence must be mapped for each issue.
The link does not establish complete procedural coverage or accept the local conversion.

ro-portal-33817.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-33817.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 1 December 2024.
ro-portal-33817.scope: Official consolidated OG nr. 27/2002 regulating the handling of petitions by public authorities.
ro-portal-33817.reviewed_content: The page identifies the instrument and subject; Articles 1 and 2 define the petitions framework and its scope.
limitations: The displayed cutoff is 1 December 2024; check a later material change when relevant.
A petition route is not a substitute for the legal-administrative complaint or court remedy under the applicable law.
This decision does not establish complete administrative-procedure coverage.

ro-portal-140280.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-140280.version_or_cutoff: Portal page displayed consolidated-form history through 3 November 2024.
ro-portal-140280.scope: Official consolidated OUG nr. 51/2008 on public legal aid in civil matters, including administrative matters listed in Article 3.
ro-portal-140280.reviewed_content: The page identifies the act and date history. Articles 1–5 were reviewed: they describe legal aid's access-to-justice purpose, covered applicants including persons domiciled or habitually resident in another EU Member State, covered administrative cases, and the financial-needs condition.
limitations: This previously missing source is now recorded as an official link; it is not added to the local-copy or monitoring manifest.
The displayed cutoff is 3 November 2024; check a later material change when relevant.
The eligibility calculation, evidence, application process, available aid and its interaction with administrative proceedings still require topic-level review.

ro-portal-309058.publisher: Portal Legislativ, Romanian Government legal-information portal
ro-portal-309058.version_or_cutoff: CCR Decision nr. 664 of 25 November 2025, published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 268 on 2 April 2026.
ro-portal-309058.scope: Official constitutional-court decision concerning Article 9 of Law nr. 554/2004 and court challenges involving government ordinances.
ro-portal-309058.reviewed_content: The page identifies the issuing court, decision, publication, subject and operative part. The constitutional challenge was rejected as unfounded.
limitations: The decision is not migration-specific and does not resolve an immigration merits issue.
It is a single decision, not a complete interpretation of Article 9 or a substitute for checking the statute and other relevant decisions.
This link does not accept the local conversion or any broader case-law summary.

human_review_site_offers.site_name: Portal Legislativ — Romanian national legislation portal
human_review_site_offers.offer: Offer the whole official Portal Legislativ website for human review of the Law nr. 544/2001 and HG nr. 123/2002 records. The research viewer returned 502 for both direct record links and timed out on the portal root; other Portal Legislativ records loaded and displayed publisher identity and consolidated-history metadata. The two records remain listed in the existing pack and are not being treated as unusable.
human_review_site_offers.review_scope: Open both records from within the official portal, confirm instrument identity and the latest government-published consolidation/date, and review the operative text used for access-to-information requests, exceptions, complaints and implementation. Use the closest official consolidated version; a complete Gazette-fragment chain is not required.
